mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product ( category_id, name, author, publisher, price, stock_quantity, description, status, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{price}, #{stockQuantity}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )

INSERT INTO product_image ( product_id, original_file_name, stored_file_name, image_path, image_type, sort_order ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{originalFileName}, #{storedFileName}, #{imagePath}, #{imageType}, #{sortOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, c.category_name, p.name, p.author, p.publisher, p.price, p.stock_quantity, p.description, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT product_image_id, image_path, image_type, sort_order FROM product_image WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
